lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Was there any gurgling going on or anything like that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How deep did the knife go in when Steven stabbed her? Do you know?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How do you know he stabbed her? (pause) Simple question.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Cuz after then when he told me ta stab her there was a hole in her stomach.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did he tell you where ta stab her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You just stabbed her in the stomach. How deep did you put the knife in?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Show us with your fingers. (Brendan demonstrates)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What did it feel like when you did that? I mean did you hit anything when you went into her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Take my pen and show me, what you would, how you did it.
